<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SignUp" name="Sign-up request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Update" name="Update, enhancement or renewal notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CancelRequest" name="Cancellation request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Subscription">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Subscription" name="Subscription Service" processRef="Process_Subscription"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SignUp" name="Sign-up with personal and payment information" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_SignUp" messageRef="Msg_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Update" name="Send update or renewal notice" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Msg_Update"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CancelRequest" name="Submit cancellation request" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Event_CancelRequest" messageRef="Msg_CancelRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Service Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StartBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Updates_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_Update</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Cancel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_CancelRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancellation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Adjustment_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Adjustment_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SignUp" name="Customer signs up">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SignUp" messageRef="Msg_SignUp"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account and assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StartBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Updates_Merge" name="Subscription active">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Update" name="Send update, enhancement or renewal notification">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cancel_Split" name="Customer decides to cancel?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CancelRequest" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CancelRequest" messageRef="Msg_CancelRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" name="Refund or charge due per terms?" default="Flow_12">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge" name="Refund or charge settled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_StartBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_StartBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge" targetRef="SendTask_Update"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="SendTask_Update" targetRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" name="No cancellation" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Updates_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" name="Cancellation decided" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Event_CancelRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Event_CancelRequest" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${chargeDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="No refund or charge" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CancelRequest" name="Cancellation request received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CancelRequest" messageRef="Msg_CancelRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancellation" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" name="Refund or charge due per terms?" default="Flow_15">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge" name="Refund or charge handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Task_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_AssignAccess" targetRef="Task_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="SendTask_RegularUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="SendTask_RegularUpdates" targetRef="SendTask_ProductEnhancements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="SendTask_ProductEnhancements" targetRef="SendTask_RenewalNotifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_RenewalNotifications" targetRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="No cancellation" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="Cancellation decided" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Event_CancelRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_CancelRequest" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancellation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancellation" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${chargeDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="No refund or charge" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Service Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Begin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_EnterInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_SubmitCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_AssignAccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_TriggerBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Loop_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_RegularUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_ProductEnhancements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SendTask_RenewalNotifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Cancel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Adjustment_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ServiceTask_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Adjustment_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>UserTask_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SignUp" name="Sign up for subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterInfo" name="Enter personal and payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_AssignAccess" name="Assign access">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_TriggerBilling" name="Trigger billing cycles">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop_Merge" name="Subscription continues">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RegularUpdates" name="Send regular updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_ProductEnhancements" name="Send product enhancements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RenewalNotifications" name="Send renewal notifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cancel_Split" name="Customer decides to cancel?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SubmitCancel" name="Submit cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" name="Refund or charge due per terms?" default="Flow_17">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge" name="Refund or charge handled">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="UserTask_SignUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="UserTask_SignUp" targetRef="UserTask_EnterInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterInfo" targetRef="ServiceTask_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="ServiceTask_GenerateAccount" targetRef="ServiceTask_AssignAccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="ServiceTask_AssignAccess" targetRef="ServiceTask_TriggerBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="ServiceTask_TriggerBilling" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="SendTask_RegularUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="SendTask_RegularUpdates" targetRef="SendTask_ProductEnhancements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_ProductEnhancements" targetRef="SendTask_RenewalNotifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="SendTask_RenewalNotifications" targetRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="No cancellation" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Cancellation decided" sourceRef="Gateway_Cancel_Split" targetRef="UserTask_SubmitCancel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${cancellationRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="UserTask_SubmitCancel" targetRef="UserTask_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="UserTask_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="ServiceTask_ApplyRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="ServiceTask_ApplyCharge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${chargeDue == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="No refund or charge" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="ServiceTask_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="ServiceTask_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Merge" targetRef="UserTask_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="UserTask_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
